name: Break glass / Group posture
text:
let btg = users
| where userPrincipalName in~ ({Accounts})
| project userId = id, upn = userPrincipalName, enabled = coalesce(accountEnabled, false), synced = coalesce(onPremisesSyncEnabled, false), userType, assignedLicenses, passwordPolicies, lastPasswordChangeDateTime, signInActivity, transitiveMemberOf, ownedObjects;
let ca = identity_conditionalAccess_policies
| project policy = displayName, state, exUsers = conditions.users.excludeUsers, exGroups = conditions.users.excludeGroups, exRoles = conditions.users.excludeRoles,
    inUsers = conditions.users.includeUsers, inGroups = conditions.users.includeGroups, inRoles = conditions.users.includeRoles, k = 1;
let grp = groups
| where displayName in~ ({BtgGroups})
| project groupId = id, group = displayName, assignable = coalesce(isAssignableToRole, false), groupTypes, membershipRule, synced = coalesce(onPremisesSyncEnabled, false),
    security = coalesce(securityEnabled, false), mail = coalesce(mailEnabled, false), owners, members;
let grpMembers = grp
| mv-expand m = members
| project groupId, group, type = tostring(m.objectType), name = tostring(m.displayName), memberUpn = tostring(m.userPrincipalName);
union
    (print wanted = {BtgGroups}
    | mv-expand typed = wanted to typeof(string)
    | extend lower = tolower(typed)
    | join kind=leftanti (grp | project lower = tolower(group)) on lower
    | project Category = "SYS", Check = "SYS.ResolveGroup", Target = typed, Status = "FAIL", Detail = "No group has this display name, so it isn't checked."),
    (grp | project Category = "GRP", Check = "GRP.RoleAssignable", Target = group, Status = iff(assignable, "PASS", "FAIL"),
        Detail = iff(assignable, "Role-assignable: only a Privileged Role Administrator or Global Administrator can change its members.", "Not role-assignable. A Groups Administrator or an owner could add themselves and inherit the Conditional Access exclusion.")),
    (grp | project Category = "GRP", Check = "GRP.StaticMembership", Target = group, Status = iff(set_has_element(groupTypes, "DynamicMembership") or isnotempty(membershipRule), "FAIL", "PASS"),
        Detail = iff(set_has_element(groupTypes, "DynamicMembership") or isnotempty(membershipRule), strcat("Dynamic membership (", membershipRule, "). Changing an attribute could add an account to the exclusion."), "Assigned (static) membership.")),
    (grp | project Category = "GRP", Check = "GRP.CloudOnly", Target = group, Status = iff(synced, "FAIL", "PASS"),
        Detail = iff(synced, "Synced from on-premises AD, so its members can be changed there.", "Cloud-only group.")),
    (grp | where not(security) or mail | project Category = "GRP", Check = "GRP.SecurityGroup", Target = group, Status = "WARN",
        Detail = strcat("securityEnabled is ", security, ", mailEnabled is ", mail, ". Expect a plain security group.")),
    (grp | project Category = "GRP", Check = "GRP.NoOwners", Target = group, Status = case(isnull(owners), "ERROR", array_length(owners) > 0, "WARN", "PASS"),
        Detail = case(isnull(owners), "The group's owners couldn't be read (needs GroupMember.Read.All or Directory.Read.All).", array_length(owners) > 0, strcat(array_length(owners), " owner(s). Owners can change its members; prefer none, managed by Global Administrators."), "No owners.")),
    (grp
    | join kind=leftouter (grpMembers | summarize nonUsers = make_set_if(name, type != "user") by groupId) on groupId
    | extend nonUsers = coalesce(nonUsers, dynamic([]))
    | project Category = "GRP", Check = "GRP.OnlyUsers", Target = group, Status = case(isnull(members), "ERROR", array_length(nonUsers) > 0, "FAIL", "PASS"),
        Detail = case(isnull(members), "The group's members couldn't be read, so its members aren't checked (needs GroupMember.Read.All or Directory.Read.All).", array_length(nonUsers) > 0, strcat("Has members that aren't users (nested groups, service principals or devices): ", strcat_array(nonUsers, ", "), "."), "Every member is a user.")),
    (grpMembers
    | where type == "user"
    | join kind=leftanti (btg | project memberUpn = upn) on memberUpn
    | project Category = "GRP", Check = "GRP.UnexpectedMember", Target = strcat(group, " | ", memberUpn), Status = "WARN",
        Detail = "A member of the group that isn't in Accounts. It inherits the group's exclusions: add it to Accounts or remove it from the group."),
    (ca
    | where state != "disabled"
    | join kind=inner (grp | project groupId, group, k = 1) on k
    | where not(set_has_element(exGroups, groupId))
    | project Category = "CA", Check = "CA.GroupNotExcluded", Target = strcat(group, " | ", policy), Status = "WARN",
        Detail = "The break-glass group isn't in the policy's excluded groups (its accounts may still be excluded one by one).")
| extend Rank = case(Status == "FAIL", 0, Status == "ERROR", 1, Status == "WARN", 2, Status == "INFO", 3, 4)
| order by Rank asc, Category asc, Check asc, Target asc
| project Category, Check, Target, Status, Detail
